# Third-party provenance

- SQLite amalgamation 3.50.4: https://www.sqlite.org/2025/sqlite-amalgamation-3500400.zip . SQLite is in the public domain; the source header states its dedication. Included sqlite3.c, sqlite3.h and sqlite3ext.h are upstream bytes.
- Catch2 2.13.10: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/catchorg/Catch2/v2.13.10/single_include/catch2/catch.hpp . Boost Software License 1.0; the header contains copyright and license notice. Separate license is included.
- libsodium 1.0.20: https://download.libsodium.org/libsodium/releases/libsodium-1.0.20.tar.gz . ISC license included inside the unmodified source archive. Build/runtime installation is separate; the offline script can build it locally.

Version pins describe the artifacts tested in this project; they are not a promise that future security updates are unnecessary. Review dependency advisories before real school deployment.
